title: Horeb and from Nebo and from Pisgah
html_source:
All biblical mountains
Horeb: Place where Moses received the 10 Commandments (aka Mt. Sinai)
Nebo: Place from which Moses was granted a view of the promised land
Pisgah): thought to refer to the same mountain as Mt. Nebo
